verdict.rationale: Docs show the building blocks for programmatic account provisioning — Entities represent customers with API-based validations (docs-12, docs-27), Account Numbers can be created and managed programmatically (docs-7, docs-17, docs-18), FDIC insurance is available via IntraFi network banks (docs-13), and every API/dashboard feature (implying account creation) has full sandbox parity (docs-6, docs-25, docs-26). Community evidence corroborates that Increase sits atop real partner banks (comm-1), confirming genuine insured deposits rather than a mock/dummy account. missing for 10: an explicit documented 'create account' endpoint or full application-to-active-account workflow walkthrough, explicit underwriting/approval timeline, and independent hands-on confirmation that the full flow (entity->account) works end-to-end in sandbox before going live.
